• A smoother, gentler wake-up
We’ve refined gradual volume increase to help your melody build more smoothly toward your wake-up time, with better continuity between alarm playback stages.

• Improved alarm reliability
Better scheduling, recovery, and audio handling on newer iOS versions. We’ve addressed situations where opening PureWake around the alarm time could interrupt playback or make it unexpectedly quiet, and improved coordination with the system alarm.

• Expanded Siri and Shortcuts support
Create and adjust alarms using actions for wake-up time, name, repeat days, melody, fade-in, and snooze preferences. More detailed shortcuts can also include your landscape and sleep-sound settings.

Dedicated actions support creating, updating, deleting, snoozing, and dismissing PureWake alarms through supported system integrations, connecting commands to your existing alarms and settings.

• Clearer alarm controls
Refined Stop and Snooze controls and better coordination between the app and system alarm make it easier to understand and manage a ringing alarm.

• Shake to snooze
When enabled, a deliberate shake can postpone an alarm during supported alarm playback. Improved motion detection helps distinguish intentional shaking from accidental bumps or simply picking up your phone. Settings now explain this feature more clearly.

The alarm that won't stop until you show up.
To turn off Rise & Show, get out of bed, show today's random object, like your bathroom sink, fridge or front door, to your iPhone's camera, then finish 2 quick challenges.
Free. No ads. No account. Camera images never leave your iPhone.

By the time the alarm stops, you're already up.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your alarm. Pick a time, then allow alarms and the camera. It rings even on Silent and in a Focus.
2. Tell it what's in your home. Select at least 3 everyday things, as far away from your bed as possible. They need no photos, because your iPhone already knows them.
3. Get a surprise each morning. Your alarm asks for a random object from your list, so you can't plan around it the night before. Prefer the same object every day? Choose it for each alarm.
4. Finish 3 steps to stop it. Tap Start mission, then:
• Step 1: walk to today's object and show it to the camera.
• Steps 2 and 3: two random challenges. Easy math (3 sums like 15 + 13), typing a short sentence, or a 3×3 sliding number puzzle.

EVERYDAY OBJECTS
• Instant setup, no photos: bathroom sink, toilet, shower or bath, front door, fridge, microwave, washing machine.
• Added later in Settings › My objects: a coffee machine, or something else of your own, learned from 6 quick photos.
• You always keep at least 3 objects, so every morning is a real surprise.

HARD TO IGNORE
• Rings even on Silent and in a Focus, using Apple's AlarmKit.
• Pressing Stop on the Lock Screen doesn't end it. Backup alarms keep ringing for up to an hour until all 3 steps are done.
• Closing the app during the mission doesn't work either. The alarm comes back automatically.
• A photo on another screen doesn't count.
• Snooze is off by default. Turn it on for an alarm to snooze once, for 5 minutes.
• A gentle stay-awake check rings 3 minutes after you finish, so you don't slide back under the covers. It's on by default, and you can turn it off.

NEVER TRAPPED
• Can't find today's object? After 3 minutes, "Can't find it? Solve math instead" swaps step 1 for 5 math questions. Steps 2 and 3 still follow.
• Dark room? The torch turns on by itself, and there's a torch button too.

A BETTER MORNING
• Pick a sound from Gentle, Loud or Funny, with a preview.
• Try it any time: Settings › Test alarm rings in 10 seconds.
• See what time you got up and how long it took.
• Build a daily streak and share a morning card. It never includes a photo.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Object recognition runs 100% on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework.
• Camera frames are analyzed in memory and never stored or uploaded. No photos or video are kept.
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no tracking and no third-party SDKs.
• For objects you set up with the camera, only numeric image fingerprints are kept, which can't be turned back into a picture. Your data is backed up only to your own private iCloud, which the developer can't access.

FREE. NO TRIAL. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Every feature is free. No paywall and no in-app purchases.

A NOTE ON SAFETY
Any object on your list can be picked, so choose only things you can reach safely while sleepy. Avoid stairs, turn on a light and take your time.

Requires iPhone with iOS 26 or later.
Need help? Visit the support page linked on this page.

FIVE WAYS TO WAKE UP

• Scan: save a barcode or QR code away from your bed, then get up and scan it.

YOUR ALARM, YOUR ROUTINE

BUILT AROUND YOUR DEVICE

On iOS 26 and later, Ember uses Apple's AlarmKit for system alarms. Locked-screen walking uses temporary workout support and requires the relevant permissions. Alarm behavior depends on your iOS version and device settings.

results.description:
The morning before an exam, the first day at a new job, a 6 AM flight — some mornings you simply can't sleep through.

AlarmK is a mission-based wake-up alarm built on iOS 26 AlarmKit. Because it uses system-level alarms, it rings through Silent and Focus modes. To dismiss it, you complete a mission — scan a QR code by your bathroom door, solve a math problem, or shake the phone — something that actually requires you to be out of bed.

▶ Why AlarmK
- AlarmKit-based system alarms: same permission model as Apple's Clock app, rings through Silent and Focus
- Mission wake-up: QR/barcode, math, memory, typing, shake, squats, walk, object hunt — 8 missions (chain up to 5, with a practice mode)
- Object hunt: register things around your home, such as the washing machine or kitchen sink, then photograph the ones picked at random when the alarm rings. Checked on your iPhone, never saved
- Deny the system alarm permission and AlarmK won't save an alarm it can't ring — it says why and takes you to Settings
- Wake Report: 7-day wake patterns, mission success rate, streaks

▶ Critical Mode for the mornings that matter
An eight-item night-before checklist: AlarmKit permission, iPhone charging, Silent mode, Focus mode, a saved QR/barcode for this alarm, Apple Watch pairing, a Clock-app backup alarm, and notification permission. iOS gives apps no way to read the ringer switch, and AlarmK doesn't read your Focus status, so those two rows tell you how tomorrow's alarm will be delivered instead. The Clock backup is yours to make — AlarmK never creates one; tick that row once you have. The reliability score counts only rows that settled on a clear pass or fail. Anything not ready says so on the spot.

▶ Live Activity & Dynamic Island
As the alarm gets close, a countdown appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. When it fires, tap the secondary button to jump straight into your mission. The same countdown appears in the Apple Watch Smart Stack.

▶ Widgets · Siri · Shift work
- Home and Lock Screen widgets show your next alarm and countdown
- Siri & Shortcuts: set alarms, check the next one, start a nap timer, skip an occurrence — without opening the app
- Shift rotations (N days on / M days off), optional Korean public-holiday skip, and a fixed-instant option for dated alarms
- An optional bedtime reminder and the wake check guard both ends of the night

▶ iCloud sync
Your alarm definitions sync via your own iCloud (private database). Switch iPhones and your alarms come with you. Your alarm data is never sent to our servers, and we can't see it.

▶ Honest about the limits
- A phone that's powered off, has 0% battery, or has alarm permissions denied — no alarm app can wake you. AlarmK focuses on flagging those risks before they bite.
- If the system alarm permission is denied, AlarmK refuses to save or switch on a new alarm rather than let it fail quietly at 6 AM. Alarms saved before the permission was turned off keep trying as notifications — with the ringer switch on Silent they may make no sound, and a Lock Screen card tells you where you stand.

▶ Privacy
- Camera and motion permissions are used only during missions and object setup
- QR scans are verified on-device, never transmitted
- No third-party analytics — no Google Analytics, no Facebook SDK
- QR secrets sync end-to-end encrypted in your iCloud Keychain (device-only if you turn iCloud Keychain off)

▶ FAQ
Q. What happens if I turn off iCloud?
A. iOS removes the synced alarms from this iPhone, and AlarmK cancels their system alarms. Signing back in to the same account restores alarms that had already synced.

Q. My alarm didn't fire.
A. First check that the system alarm permission, notification permission, and notification sound are all on. Opening the Critical Mode checklist reviews those plus battery and charging, Silent mode and Focus, and points at whatever isn't ready.

---
Privacy Policy: https://alarmk.com/privacy
Support: https://alarmk.com/help

results.description:
The ultimate alarm clock that physically forbids "just 5 more minutes!"
This app was developed for those who find themselves oversleeping or hitting snooze repeatedly. This is a "must-move-to-stop" alarm.

■ Strong Points
1. Exercise is Required to Stop
Once the alarm goes off, the loud sound will not stop until you perform a set amount of physical movement (shaking or moving the phone). Your brain and body will be forced to wake up while you move, breaking the cycle of oversleeping.

2. New Feature: Sleep Mode (Pseudo-Sleep)
Eliminate the risk of the alarm not going off due to missed notifications. By activating the dedicated Sleep Mode, the app stays in the foreground while keeping the screen dark until morning. It ensures the alarm wakes you up with maximum volume.

3. Two Modes for Different Situations
- Alarm Mode: For your daily morning wake-up.
- Timer Mode: To prevent oversleeping during power naps or short rests.

■ Critical Settings for Guaranteed Results
To ensure this app wakes you up every time, we strongly recommend the following:

- Allow Push Notifications
Be sure to select "Allow" when the popup appears during installation. If you declined, please turn it ON via Settings > [App Name] > Notifications.

It has a feature that allows you to listen to sleeping music when you are ready to retire for the night.
Through this feature, users can be smoothly lead off to sleep.


WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:

The planning for this app started when we happened to hear from a nursery school teacher that, "The children always sleep well on rainy days."

Through further investigation, we heard the same thing, not just from other nursery school teachers, but many mothers as well.

But, through what mechanism this was happening by remained unclear. There are various theories, such as an atmospheric pressure theory (it was due to low atmospheric pressure), a light intensity theory (it was due to the sky being dark and cloudy), and a sound theory (it was due to the sound of rain being close to an f/1 tremor).

We decided to focus on the sound theory and added a feature, to a basic alarm clock app that plays sleeping music, such as the sound of rain.

Wake up more naturally with your wake-up light based on your smart HomeKit lights, and improve your morning routine with Wake Up Light.

Are you tired in the morning? Does your body feel like it doesn't want to get up? Create an artificial dawn with Wake Up Light, so getting up in the morning feels easier and more natural. Built for use with HomeKit-enabled lights, now it’s easy to add a wake-up light alarm to the Apple Home app.

Say you want to wake up at 8:00 a.m. Use Wake Up Light to schedule your bed light to turn on at 7:30 am with its minimum brightness in a dark reddish color. Your light will then gradually increase its brightness and change its color to daylight white until it reaches its full brightness at 8:00 a.m. Got smart blinds? Let them gradually open 20 minutes before your wake-up time. Coffee machine plugged into a smart outlet? Let it turn on 15 minutes before your alarm goes off.

Set a light alarm that starts your day before your desired wake-up time (a recommended duration is something between 30 and 60 minutes). Your light brightens to its maximum intensity by the time you’ve set it, shifting from dim, warm red to bright and cold white after its light-up duration. The brighter the light, the better the effect will be on your body. The goal is to put you into a lighter sleep so that you awaken easier.

FEATURES
– Alarms that turn on lights and change colors as they brighten
– Support for all HomeKit-enabled lights, blinds and outlets
– Alarms are shared with everyone who has access to the same home
– There is no need to keep your iPhone connected (or even on)
– Set the days your wake-up light should wake you
– Combine lightbulbs, power outlets, and smart blinds
– Shortcuts and Siri support to activate, reschedule and deactivate your alarms
– Create multiple wake-up lights and control multiple accessories per alarm
– Preview your wake-up light

Wake Up Light lets you easily create wake-up lights that fit your needs. Just select your light and preferred wake-up time, and Wake Up Light will create HomeKit automation for you, turning your lights on gradually over time.

Adjust the duration of the brightening phase (between 30 and 60 minutes is recommended) and choose the brightness your lights should reach. Your light then brightens to its maximum intensity by the time you have chosen, shifting from dim, warm red to bright and cold white after its light-up duration (if supported by the light bulb).

Add multiple wake-up lights to your weekly schedule. Control different lights with their own custom time, duration and brightness. Everyone in the same house can control the wake-up lights, too – thanks to HomeKit.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

A wake-up light alarm clock brings you slowly into shallower states of sleep by gradually increasing the brightness in your room. The light travels through your closed eyelids, notifying your body the same way as a natural sunrise. This gradual transition from deeper to shallower states of sleep has been found to wake you more naturally and boost your mood, energy and productivity for the whole day.

Let your lights brighten your morning.

results.description:
Wonder Alarm is an intelligent alarm clock application that integrates sleep tracking, personalized wake-up methods, interactive challenges, and AI-driven smart alerts. It transforms the mundane act of waking up into a scientifically managed daily ritual, helping users achieve more efficient recovery and a refreshed morning state.

## Sleep Analysis · Multi-Dimensional Insights

Wonder Alarm goes beyond basic sleep duration tracking, delving into multiple metrics including deep sleep duration, sleep continuity, respiratory rhythm, and recovery quality, transforming overnight sleep data into a clearly readable analytical dashboard. Each morning, users receive not merely a composite score, but a clear understanding of "what contributes to quality sleep" and "where improvements can be made," providing reliable data support for subsequent sleep schedule adjustments.


## Custom Alarms · Your Way to Wake

Alarms should not follow a one-size-fits-all approach. Wonder Alarm offers three customizable alarm sound options: converting any text into spoken voice, recording personal voice as wake-up instructions, or directly selecting music tracks from the device's local library. From gentle voice prompts to rhythmically engaging musical arrangements, each user can establish the most suitable wake-up method based on personal preference.


## Forced Game Challenges · A Definitive End to Snoozing

The only way to dismiss the alarm is to complete a preset challenge — encompassing various game types such as memory matching, rapid arithmetic, and device shaking. During the tens of seconds spent focused on problem-solving, the brain gradually transitions out of sleep inertia, with fingers and mind activating in unison. By the time the challenge is completed, drowsiness has largely subsided, achieving a wake-up effect that promotes rapid mental clarity.


## Alarm Clock Widget · The Desktop Manifestation of Sleep Monitoring

While monitoring sleep quality throughout the night, Wonder Alarm simultaneously transforms into an elegant desktop clock widget. Time, sleep duration, and current status are clearly displayed on the screen, combining the visual appeal of a professional timepiece with the practical functionality of sleep tracking. The two capabilities are seamlessly integrated, occupying no additional space, requiring no extra operations, and allowing users to view a complete overnight sleep report each morning.


## AI Wake-Up · Awakening at the Optimal Moment

The sleep phase — whether deep sleep or light sleep — at the moment the alarm sounds significantly impacts the waking experience. Wonder Alarm analyzes sleep cycles in real time and intelligently identifies the optimal wake-up moment within the light sleep window preceding the user's scheduled alarm time. The AI alarm gradually increases volume to guide users naturally out of sleep, avoiding the discomfort of abrupt awakening. Users wake with mental clarity and more complete energy recovery.

---

1. Unrestricted access to all features.

Please note that the Apple iTunes account will be automatically debited 24 hours prior to expiration. Upon successful deduction, the subscription term will be extended by one subscription cycle.
